ola-en-01-tip.caption: By February most of what this year taught you will be gone, because nobody writes it down. Do it now, while the year is still in your head, and keep the page somewhere you will actually look in January.
ola-en-01-tip.ask: Save this and give it a quiet evening before December fills up.
ola-en-01-tip.title: What this year taught you, on one page

ola-en-02-acq.caption: Every limited company runs on a handful of dates, and somebody has to be the one watching them. With us that is a named job, not an evening task. We start early and send things out with room to read them.
ola-en-02-acq.ask: Share this with a director who keeps every date in their own head.
ola-en-02-acq.title: The filing calendar, off your desk and onto ours

ola-en-03-acq.caption: Nobody is born able to read a set of accounts. It is a skill, and it is far quicker learnt sitting next to someone who does it all day. Come with one figure you have never been sure of.
ola-en-03-acq.ask: Keep this for the next set of accounts that tells you nothing.
ola-en-03-acq.title: Bring one figure you have never been sure of

ola-en-04-joke.caption: I asked a client how the year had gone. He said busy. Then he went quiet. Busy and profitable are not the same thing, and the difference only shows up once somebody adds it all up properly.
ola-en-04-joke.ask: Send this to the busiest person you know.
ola-en-04-joke.title: I asked how the year had gone. He said busy.

ola-en-05-quote.caption: Nothing worth having in a business is built in a burst. The accounts, the client list, the name people pass on: all of it is the same small thing done again when nobody is watching.
ola-en-05-quote.ask: Share this with someone in the slow part of building something.
ola-en-05-quote.title: Not by strength, but by perseverance
